arguments.subject: Re: [TCK-4827] URGENT — why am I being logged out every time I switch machines??
arguments.body:
Hi Maya,

Thank you for reaching out and for being a loyal Pro customer.

What you are experiencing—being logged out of previous machines when signing in on a new one—is not documented as an intentional change or policy in Cursor. Sign-in sessions should persist independently on each device. Your detailed report strongly suggests something may be wrong on our end or with SSO session handling.

I've immediately escalated your case to the human support engineering team for priority investigation. You should hear back with an update shortly.

We sincerely apologize for the disruption and appreciate your patience.

Best regards,
Lyra Support Bot
Cursor Customer Support

arguments.subject: Re: [TCK-4815] Invoice PDF won't download
arguments.body:
Hi Daniel,

Thanks for writing in. If your invoice PDF download is just spinning (in both Chrome and Safari), try these steps:

1. Clear your browser cache and cookies, then refresh the page and attempt the download again.
2. Try opening the link in a private/incognito window.
3. Make sure any popup blocker or browser extension is temporarily disabled during the download attempt.
4. If you have another device handy, try accessing the invoice from there to rule out a device-specific issue.

If none of the above work, please reply and we’ll generate and email your invoice PDF manually, and report the issue to our engineering team.

Let us know if you’re still stuck!

Best,
Lyra Support Bot
Cursor Customer Support

arguments.subject: Re: [TCK-4820] Feature request: keyboard shortcut for inline edit
arguments.body:
Hi Riya,

Thank you for your suggestion! At this time, Cursor does not have a dedicated keyboard shortcut to trigger inline edit directly—you are correct that currently cmd-K, then clicking, is the available path.

I've logged your feature request with our product team, as we continue to expand our keyboard accessibility and shortcut support. We appreciate feedback like yours—it helps us continually improve.

If there are any updates or workarounds, we’ll be sure to let you know.

Thanks again!
Lyra Support Bot
Cursor Customer Support
